|game_text='''Front side — [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 0 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 4 · Hyperspeed 6<br />Icons: [[Nav Computer]] [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Has ship-docking capability. While [Episode VII] Han or Rey piloting, maneuver +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if at a site, may flip this card (even if unpiloted).

'''Back side — [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle|Combat]]), Heavily-Modified Light Freighter'''

Destiny 7 · Power 3 · Deploy 0 · Forfeit 7 · Maneuver 5 · Landspeed 2<br />Icons: [[Resistance]] [[Scomp Link]] [[Episode VII]]

May not be placed in Reserve Deck. If Falcon about to leave table, place it out of play. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable. While Finn or Rey aboard, immune to attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 6 if both). Once during your move phase, if piloted, may flip this card.

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 6) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5). The images are the Players Committee printings of this version (both sides of the card, or the errata sheet slips printed for it). Each version below is a published PC printing of the card (card images of both sides, or an errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository, slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card images of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card images uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-204_35-0">Players Committee card images <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018); <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, bottom margin “•Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: no errata mark, bottom margin “•Special Modifications”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-204_35-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbage.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository); only the combat vehicle (back) side image changed. '''What changed:''' back side: a second card image, <code>thefalconjunkyardgarbage.gif</code>, in the same first commit: “Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable.” → “Immune to Trample and Unsalvageable, even if unpiloted.”, with the errata mark “E” (its file name has no front/back suffix; the errata'd back side was published before the repository began). A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E”, bottom margin “•Special Modifications”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 2)]]): PC card images uploaded 21 December 2021<ref name="img-204_35-2">Players Committee card images <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1 8190af8] (21 December 2021); <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8190af827ca5ef713205ed8648e28428656b00b1 8190af8] (21 December 2021). The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref>. '''What changed:''' new card images of both sides at higher resolution (about 350×490 → 745×1039 pixels): the margins lose their uniqueness dots, the back side's errata mark “E” → “E1” and its image carries the “even if unpiloted” text of the errata. A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E1”, bottom margin “Special Modifications”.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 3)]]): PC errata sheet slips (updated_flip_cards.pdf, page 2), PDF dated 21 March 2022<ref name="slip-204_35-3">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/updated_flip_cards.pdf#page=2 updated_flip_cards.pdf], page 2 (PDF dated 21 March 2022).</ref>. '''What changed:''' both sides printed as slips on the PC's “Updated Flip Cards” sheet (March 2022): errata marks “E2” on both sides, and the back side's bottom margin “Special Modifications” → “Legendary Starfighter”; the words are the same. A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: errata mark “E2”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E2”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 4)]]): PC card images uploaded 23 March 2022<ref name="img-204_35-4">Players Committee card images <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/422d2ae00c7d5e8b247435ea650a8685714bc358 422d2ae] (23 March 2022); <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/422d2ae00c7d5e8b247435ea650a8685714bc358 422d2ae] (23 March 2022). The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref>. '''What changed:''' new card images of both sides following the March 2022 slips: the back side's errata mark “E1” → “E2” and its bottom margin “Special Modifications” → “Legendary Starfighter”; the front image still prints no errata mark; the words are the same. A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E2”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”.
* '''PC-E5''' ([[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage / •The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (Errata 5)]]): PC card images uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-204_35-5">Players Committee card images <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbagefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/thefalconjunkyardgarbageback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The commit date is the upload date; the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/.</ref>. '''What changed:''' both sides re-made (the icons beside the game text and the picture re-rendered; small differences, see the crops); words, marks and margins are unchanged. A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: starship (front) side: no errata mark, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”; combat vehicle (back) side: errata mark “E2”, bottom margin “Legendary Starfighter”. It is the current printing.
